blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for houses in Lower Mary Hill. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Port Coquitlam total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in Lower Mary Hill fell from 14 in June to 11 in September (−21.4%), and 11 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 7.2% of Port Coquitlam’s 153 houses listed.

blocks.text: Lower Mary Hill home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

11 houses sold in Lower Mary Hill with a median price of $1,255,000 (the middle half sold between $1,139,440 and $1,337,500), taking a median of 23 days to sell at 95.5% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median $588 per square foot, a median year built of 1975 and a median lot of 6,045 square feet.

blocks.source: Source: Paragon, the MLS® system used by Jared’s office, closed sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026. Pending sales are not counted. Median means the middle price, so half sold for more and half for less. Sold vs list is the sale price as a percentage of the last list price. A figure is shown only where at least 5 homes sold, and a row is shown only with 5 or more sales; with fewer, one sale would be the whole figure.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Lower Mary Hill?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 11 houses listed in Lower Mary Hill. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Lower Mary Hill a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses in Lower Mary Hill had a sales ratio of 18%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Lower Mary Hill from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 11 houses sold in Lower Mary Hill over those 4 months, out of 72 in all of Port Coquitlam.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Lower Mary Hill?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: What did houses in Lower Mary Hill sell for?
faq.a: 11 houses sold in Lower Mary Hill between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,255,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Lower Mary Hill?
faq.a: The median was 23 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 95.5% of the last list price (0% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
